items.subject: Field Insights
items.statement: Growing interest in mRNA platform potential beyond infectious disease, persistent questions around myocarditis risk in younger males, increasing KOL engagement with mRNA-4157 data, and market access barriers related to booster hesitancy
items.supporting_quote: Key themes observed during field interactions this period include growing interest in the mRNA platform's potential beyond infectious disease, persistent questions around myocarditis risk in younger males, and increasing KOL engagement with mRNA-4157 data. Market access barriers related to booster hesitancy were noted in several regions.
